title: eriophyllum resinosum
intro: Eriophyllum resinosum, commonly known as Resinous Fleabane, is a perennial shrub in the sunflower family that is native to the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Eriophyllum resinosum include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which may help to reduce the severity of colds and flu, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Eriophyllum resinosum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
